text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The GⅡ Swan Stakes... Accepting K.S. 
Miracle's proposal, Daiichi Ruby steps 
onto the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle has polished her speed and 
honed her form to perfection. What's more, 
Daitaku Helios and Bamboo Memory are also 
joining the fray.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
GⅠ-caliber titans gather as the crowd 
buzzes with anticipation. Amidst the 
swirling heat, the race begins...!
